infobox.usage: Unlocks a Rogue barrack at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rogue USEC barrack key (Barrack) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens one of the Rogues' makeshift barracks.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a possible location for the quest To the Light - Getting Acquainted

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: On the first floor of office building #3, which is located at the water treatment plant area in the north of Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Weapon box (6x2)
- Weapon box (4x4)
- Toolbox
- Wooden ammo box
- Physical Bitcoin spawn on the chair
- Loose weapon mods
